name: Mithyatva (Delusion)
desc: State of spiritual ignorance, attachment to false beliefs, and confusion of non-self with self.

name: Sasatana-Samyagdrishti (Downfall)
desc: Transient state when a soul slips back from enlightenment toward delusion.

name: Mishradrishti (Mixed State)
desc: State of hesitation where truth and delusion are temporarily mixed.

name: Avirata-Samyagdrishti (Vowless Right Faith)
desc: Attainment of true conviction (Samyaktva) without complete self-restraint vows.

name: Deshavirata (Partial Self-Restraint)
desc: State of Householder (Shravak) taking the 12 ethical vows and 11 Pratimas.

name: Pramatta-Samyata (Ascetic with Negligence)
desc: Ordained Monk (Sadhu) observing full vows but with subtle mental oscillations.

name: Apramatta-Samyata (Ascetic without Negligence)
desc: Vigilant Monk absorbed in deep meditation and pure spiritual absorption.

name: Nivritti-Badara-Samparaya (New Thought Activity)
desc: Intense spiritual purification destroying heavy passions.

name: Anavritti-Badara (Advanced Purity)
desc: Eradication of gross passions (anger, pride, deceit, greed).

name: Sukshma-Samparaya (Subtle Greed)
desc: Only microscopic trace of subtle greed remains.

name: Upashanta-Kashaya (Suppressed Passions)
desc: All passions completely suppressed (temporary danger of relapse).

name: Kshina-Kashaya (Destroyed Passions)
desc: Passions completely eradicated forever (no possibility of downfall).

name: Sayogi-Kevali (Omniscient with Body)
desc: Living Tirthankara / Arihant with Kevala Jnana (Omniscience) while in physical body.

name: Ayogi-Kevali (Liberated Perfection)
desc: Final motionlessness prior to discarding physical body and entering eternal Moksha as a Siddha.
